description: Sends the registration to the carriers for review. The first time it also buys the chosen toll-free number (phone_number from sms_numbers, included in the person's add-on). After a rejection it resubmits the same request with the fixes. Only after the person reviewed the form (sms_setup_status) and said yes: needs confirm: true. Every check runs again first; if one fails, nothing is sent or bought. Current API builds answer submit_in_dashboard: the submit needs the person's EIN or SSN, which Hollerpost sends straight to the carriers and does not keep, so the person submits in the dashboard (setup_url, Settings, Text messaging); pass that on. Review takes 1 to 2 weeks, sometimes a month; never promise a date. The person gets an email when the status changes. Requires API key scope: account.

phone_number.description: First submission only: the toll-free number the person picked, E.164 (+18335550100).

name: sms_registration_submit
